headline: 20k subscribers, 1,835 at risk – PKR 547,507 on the line
paragraphs: We have 20,000 paying subscribers this week and about 1,835 of them (9% of the base) are expected to cancel in the next 30 days, putting PKR 547,507 of monthly revenue at risk [F1, F2, F3].

The high‑risk group is the top 2,000 subscribers (top 10%) and represents PKR 187,604 of revenue at risk; the biggest signals are ‘watching much less than last week’ (61%), ‘failed renewals’ (54%), ‘on a Daily pack’ (41%), ‘sports series ended’ (39%) and ‘inactive 5+ days’ (39%) [F4, F5, F6, F7, F8, F9].

The riskiest plan is Daily with an average churn risk of 12% (PKR 206,377 at risk), the riskiest payment channel is Operator 4 (10% risk, PKR 62,465 at risk) and the riskiest genre is Sports (10% risk, PKR 287,883 at risk); contacting the top 10% by score catches real leavers 28% of the time, 3.01× better than random outreach [F10, F11, F12, F13]
actions: Contact the top 10% scored subscribers with a personalized win‑back message that addresses reduced watching, renewal failures and Daily‑pack concerns [F5, F6, F7, F13]
Send a limited‑time sports‑bundle discount to users flagged by the Sports genre risk to keep them engaged [F12]
Promote alternative payment methods to Operator 4 users to reduce the high churn risk on that channel [F11]
